title: Website
subtitle: The public agency website your selected theme renders.
readOnlyHint: You can view this website, but your permissions don't allow saving changes.

tabHints.home: Hero, trust points, promotion, testimonials and the closing call to action.
tabHints.tours: Which published tours the home page features, and in which order.
tabHints.navigation: The links shown in the site header.
tabHints.footer: Agency line, link columns and legal links at the bottom of the site.
tabHints.branding: Logo, colors and identity shown across the storefront.

sectionHints.hero: The first thing visitors see. Headline and subtitle render on the home page hero.
sectionHints.trustPoints: Short trust signals under the hero (for example “Certified guides”).
sectionHints.promotion: A highlighted campaign block between the hero and the tour list.
sectionHints.finalCta: The closing call to action at the bottom of the home page.
sectionHints.tours: Pick published tours to feature first on the home page, in the chosen order.
sectionHints.navigation: Links shown in the site header.
sectionHints.footerDescription: A short line about your agency at the top of the footer.
sectionHints.footerColumns: Link columns in the footer body.
sectionHints.footerLegal: Legal links shown at the bottom of the footer.
sectionHints.branding: Identity shown across the site. The storefront falls back to your agency name when empty.

empty.testimonials: No testimonials yet. Add the first one below.
empty.navigation: No navigation links yet. The storefront shows only the home link.
empty.tourCatalog: No published tours yet. Publish a trip first — featured tours are picked from your published catalog.
empty.trustPoints: No trust points yet. These become the strip under the hero.
empty.footerColumns: No footer columns yet. A column groups related links.
empty.footerLegal: No legal links yet. Most storefronts link privacy and terms here.

confirm.publishBody: Your current draft becomes the live public website. Anything edited later stays on the draft until you publish again.

notifications.invalidFields: Some fields need attention before this can be saved.
notifications.notPublished: This website is not published yet.
notifications.slugConflict: Another tenant already uses this website address. Rename the website slug before publishing.
notifications.loadFailed: The website draft is no longer available.
notifications.previewFailed: Could not open a preview of this draft.
notifications.noWebsiteUrl: This website has no public address yet.

fieldErrors.heroTitleTooLong: Keep the headline to 120 characters or fewer.
fieldErrors.valueTooLong: Keep this field within its length limit.
fieldErrors.trustPointTitleRequired: Give each trust point a title.
fieldErrors.trustPointTooMany: Keep to 6 trust points or fewer.
fieldErrors.testimonialRequired: Each testimonial needs a quote and an author.
fieldErrors.brandingNameTooLong: Keep the name to 120 characters or fewer.
fieldErrors.navigationLinkRequired: Each navigation link needs a label and a path.
fieldErrors.navigationTooMany: Keep to 20 navigation links or fewer.
fieldErrors.footerColumnTitleRequired: Give each footer column a title.
fieldErrors.footerTooMany: Keep footer blocks within their limits.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

tooltips.live: Opens the published website in a new tab.
tooltips.preview: This site is not published yet — opens a signed preview of your draft.
tooltips.devOtherTenant: In development the local storefront serves “{{tenant}}”, so the tab will show that site.
